# [TASK] Review and clear the open Dependabot PR backlog

## Task
Track the open Dependabot PR backlog as a Housekeeping Task, per #77's convention that a Dependabot merge commit references one. Records what autonomous runs found and could act on within scope discipline: no CI/CD workflow edits, no dependency bumps without an issue authorizing them.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] #167, #169 (targeted the removed `/frontend/filmpire` path): closed as stale
- [x] #170, #172 (`/frontend/lmdb` npm bumps): merged into `main` (`e262196`, `4714da9`) after a local test-suite run; #171 (`eslint` 8→10 group bump): closed with reasoning — `eslint-config-airbnb@19.0.4` requires `eslint` ^7 || ^8, incompatible with `eslint@10`
- [x] #178, #180-183 (gradle-wrapper and npm bumps): merged into `main` (`9642d10`, `8056cd9`, `1b7acb`, `4644a29`, `06c7a5c`) after local build/test/lint; #184-185 verified safe, then carried forward manually as `75d0ef6` after real merge conflicts with #180-183, and closed as superseded; #179 (same `eslint-config-airbnb` conflict as #171): closed with reasoning
- [x] #163-166, #168 (GitHub Actions bumps): editing `.github/workflows/*.yml` is outside autonomous scope (CLAUDE.md's CI/CD-edit restriction). #164, #165, #166 and #168 are merged (by the repo owner, not an autonomous run); #163 (`actions/checkout` 4→7) is still open — tracked by #120, not by this Task
- [x] `.github/dependabot.yml` targets only `/frontend/lmdb`, not the removed `/frontend/filmpire` path, and opens its PRs against `main` directly (`target-branch: "main"` in the gradle and npm blocks) (manual: read `.github/dependabot.yml`)

## Estimate
**Hours:** 2

## Notes
Filed 2026-08-20 by the `lmdb-autonomous-dev` scheduled run as its one bounded unit of work per CLAUDE.md's scope discipline, continued 2026-08-21 and 2026-08-27. The recurring `eslint-config-airbnb` conflict (#171, #179) needs a human decision — replace or upgrade the config — before Dependabot's dev-dependencies group PR can land automatically; not re-investigated on each recurrence. Audited by #318, re-parented under Story #77 (matches #77's first acceptance criterion on Dependabot merge commits referencing a Housekeeping Task).
